messages:
Priya M: Quick thought  propose we try a 'fastpass' lead path for inbound. Idea: do an immediate user-facing claim (10s TTL) so UX is instant, run enrichment async, and if enrichment hasn't completed by 7s move the lead to an 'overflow' RD queue. That prevents blocking the SDR UX but keeps leads in a recoverable tunnel. Thoughts? :zap:

Evan R: Sounds promising. A couple of clarifying Qs: - If HubSpot assigns an owner during enrichment, do we accept it? - How do we avoid double-assigns in RR when overflow kicks in?

Theo K: For HS/SF ownership we should only allow external owner to overwrite if our claim state is still 'pending'. Once claim flips to 'claimed' we treat external webhooks as reconciliation-only (won't reassign). Round-robin: mark overflow reservations with reserved_until = now+45s and a reserved_by token to prevent duplicates.

Priya M: Nice. So timeline: receive lead -> UI receives claimed ack (fastpass) -> kick enrichment job -> if enrichment ack <7s attach attributes; else mark overflow and notify ops channel. Keep a reconcile worker to merge late HS/SF webhooks.

OpsBot: automation: enrichment.ping received for lead lp_9001 status: queued

Evan R: Implementation snippet idea:
```
{
  "claim_id": "fp_9001",
  "lead_id": "lp_9001",
  "path": "fastpass",
  "claim_ttl_seconds": "10",
  "reserved_until": "2026-06-10T15:01:45Z",
  "status": "reserved|active|overflow"
}
```
Reconcilier will run every 10s to process late webhooks and merge fields.

Theo K: Metrics we should add: lead.fastpass.latency_p50/p95, lead.fastpass.overflow_rate, lead.fastpass.reconcile_late_count. Add Grafana alert if overflow_rate > 1.5% sustained for 10m. Also log enrichment delta and webhook lag for postmortem.

Priya M: On HubSpot side we need to ensure our webhook handler respects HS automation that may set lifecycle stage. If HS sends assign.owner for an existing owner, reconcile worker should append note rather than overwrite. For SF mapper: map owner_external_id -> sf_owner_id on reconcile only.

salesforce-bot: webhook: contact.update received for lp_9001 owner_external_id: 3421 status: delivered

Evan R: Edge case: duplicates from multiple intake connectors (docs, webinar, api). Use canonical key (email + source_fingerprint) dedupe before claiming. If dup found during enrichment, merge attributes and prefer earliest claimed timestamp for ownership decisions.

Theo K: Also add a manual ops playbook entry: how to force-release a reservation, how to move lead from overflow back to main queue, and how to surface late-merge conflicts to SDR. I'll draft the steps.

Priya M: Action items: Evan owns webhook reconcilier spec and dedupe rules; Theo owns metrics/dashboard and ops playbook; I'll prototype the fastpass reservation TTL and overflow notifier. Target: staging rollout next Wed. :checkered_flag:

Evan R: I'll open a PR for the reconcilier and include the sample flow diagram + tests for late-webhook behavior.

Theo K: I'll stub dashboards and add the 1.5% alert. Will also add an on-call runbook note.

Priya M: Thanks all. Will post the playbook draft and a short FAQ for SDRs about overflow behavior here in the thread when ready. If anyone wants to pair on the prototype ping me. :slightly_smiling_face:
